title: ASC 280 Reportable Segment Tester
description: Applies the ASC 280-10-50-12 quantitative thresholds to one caller-declared candidate operating segment and computes the ASC 280-10-50-14 seventy-five percent coverage test. Each of the three ten percent tests is reported separately with its own denominator, including the profit-or-loss denominator, which is the greater in absolute amount of the profitable side and the loss side rather than the two netted together. Thresholds are inclusive and compared by exact cross multiplication on unrounded inputs, so an exact boundary classifies as meeting the threshold; reported percentages are rounded for display only. The five ASC 280-10-50-11 aggregation criteria are echoed back as nullable booleans, never computed, with unanswered criteria named and a management-judgment flag raised. A zero denominator reports not_assessable rather than a failing threshold. Verify-only: does not identify or aggregate operating segments and does not assert compliance.

segment_revenue_external.description: Candidate segment's revenue from external customers. Counts toward the 280-10-50-12(a) numerator.

segment_revenue_intersegment.description: Candidate segment's revenue from transactions with other operating segments. Counts toward the 280-10-50-12(a) numerator but never toward 280-10-50-14 coverage.

combined_revenue_all_reported_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(a) denominator: combined revenue, internal and external, of all reported operating segments. Caller-declared; never derived from the numerator.

segment_profit_or_loss.description: Candidate segment's reported profit or loss, signed. The absolute amount is taken for the 280-10-50-12(b) numerator, so a loss of -X classifies identically to a profit of +X.

combined_profit_of_profitable_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(b) denominator input (1): combined reported profit of all operating segments that did NOT report a loss.

combined_loss_of_loss_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(b) denominator input (2): combined reported loss of all operating segments that DID report a loss. The denominator is the greater of the two inputs in absolute amount, never the two netted together.

combined_assets_all_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(c) denominator: combined assets of all operating segments.

reportable_external_revenue.description: 280-10-50-14 numerator: cumulative EXTERNAL revenue of the reportable segments. Intersegment revenue is excluded here by the clause.

aggregation_similar_products_services.description: 280-10-50-11(a) nature of the products and services. Management judgment, echoed only. Null means unanswered, which is not false.

aggregation_similar_production_processes.description: 280-10-50-11(b) nature of the production processes. Management judgment, echoed only.

aggregation_similar_customer_type.description: 280-10-50-11(c) type or class of customer. Management judgment, echoed only.

aggregation_similar_distribution_methods.description: 280-10-50-11(d) methods used to distribute products or provide services. Management judgment, echoed only.

aggregation_similar_regulatory_environme.description: 280-10-50-11(e) nature of the regulatory environment, which the clause itself qualifies with 'if applicable'. Management judgment, echoed only.

reportable_segment_count.description: Optional count of reportable segments, used only for the non-binding practical-limit advisory that FASB Statement No. 131 paragraph 24 raises above ten.

mcp_tool_definition.name: test_asc280_reportable_segment
mcp_tool_definition.description: Tests one candidate operating segment against the three ASC 280-10-50-12 ten percent quantitative thresholds (revenue including intersegment, absolute profit or loss, assets) and computes the ASC 280-10-50-14 seventy-five percent external-revenue coverage test. Each test carries its own caller-declared denominator; the profit-or-loss denominator is the greater in absolute amount of the profitable side and the loss side, not the two netted. Thresholds are inclusive and compared without rounding. Zero denominators report not_assessable rather than failing. The five ASC 280-10-50-11 aggregation criteria are echoed back as nullable booleans and never computed. Verify-only, no compliance determination.

segment_revenue_intersegment.description: Candidate segment intersegment sales or transfers

combined_revenue_all_reported_segments.description: Combined internal and external revenue of all reported operating segments

segment_profit_or_loss.description: Candidate segment reported profit or loss, signed

combined_profit_of_profitable_segments.description: Combined reported profit of segments that did not report a loss

combined_loss_of_loss_segments.description: Combined reported loss of segments that did report a loss

combined_assets_all_segments.description: Combined assets of all operating segments

reportable_external_revenue.description: Cumulative external revenue of reportable segments

reportable_segment_count.description: Optional, drives the practical-limit advisory only
